overview: Bitch Coin is an ultra-luxury crypto meme coin website that blends high fashion aesthetics with futuristic blockchain visuals. Inspired by Gucci, Balenciaga, and Prada, the site features a cinematic peach-and-rose-gold design with 3D interactive elements, editorial typography, and diamond sparkle animations.
features: Cinematic two-column hero with video panel and editorial typography
Rotating 3D metallic coin with interactive mouse parallax
Diamond sparkle and rose-gold shimmer animations throughout
Editorial collection grid with crystal-glass card effects
Dark luxury alternating sections with peach-white light sections
Luxury membership card design in community section
Animated rose-gold circuit board background textures
Fully mobile responsive with smooth entrance animations
